answer_raw.explanation: Readmissions are driven by clinical instability and disease severity at discharge, best proxied by LengthOfStay. Standard tracked metrics (vitals, labs, adherence scores) are confounded bystanders that correlate with severity but do not causally determine readmission risk when LOS is accounted for. The diuretic titration pilot showed ~0 average effect because its impact is highly heterogeneous across patient subgroups (benefiting some, neutral or harmful in others), masking subgroup utility. The adherence program directly addresses the true mechanism: inadequate post-discharge transition support and follow-up execution for high-LOS patients. Escalating the adherence program reduces readmission rates by closing the care-gap for the highest-risk cohort.
